description:
The image depicts a small, red steam train traveling through a rural area on a sunny day. The train is shown from the front, with its black smokestack emitting a large cloud of white smoke. It is traveling along a single track on top of a bed of gravel, surrounded by grass and trees.

*   The train is a small, red steam engine with a black smokestack.
    *   It has a small chimney and a large, round smokestack emitting a large cloud of white smoke
